title: BLF: Add support for BLF_OBJTYPE_APP_TEXT Metadata segmentation
description:
Add support for BLF_APPTEXT_TRACELINE

Closes #19379

I didn't bother implementing proper fragment/segment support and simply treated consecutive objects as a single one
